lines.text: In the year King Uzziah died, Isaiah saw the Lord on a throne, and the temple filled with smoke.
Above the Lord stood seraphim with six wings, calling out that the LORD of Hosts is holy.
Isaiah said he was a man of unclean lips, and a seraph touched his eyes with a glowing coal.
When the Lord asked whom He should send, Isaiah offered to go, and he was told to make hearts calloused.
The Lord said the cities would lie ruined, and the holy seed would be like a pile of ash in the land.
